def simulate_coins(n):
    C = 2 * n + 1
    # coins[i] = 0 for Heads (H), 1 for Heads Down (D)
    coins = [0] * C
    
    # Current position pointer
    P = 0
    
    # Number of flips performed so far
    num_flips = 0
    
    # The sequence is (F1, S1), (F2, S2), ..., (F_{2n}, S_{2n}), F_{2n+1}
    
    # 1. Perform (Fk, Sk) for k = 1 to 2n
    for k in range(1, 2 * n + 1):
        # Flip k (Fk)
        coins[P] = 1 - coins[P] # Flip state
        num_flips += 1
        
        # Skip k (Sk) - Move P forward k positions
        P = (P + k) % C
        
    # 2. Perform the final flip F_{2n+1}
    # P is now positioned after S_{2n}
    coins[P] = 1 - coins[P] # Final flip
    num_flips += 1
    
    # Count heads down (1s)
    heads_down = sum(coins)
    return heads_down
